_comment: Golden values for nos-footer-colour-logos (COUNCIL-1 C2 + TYPE-11, NOS Design ruling 2026-10-28, root comms.md ~line 4940). Every number is measured from the supplied files or taken from the ruling.

transparentPadding.note: identical to the reversed-gold file it replaces (alpha > 8), so the .nf-lockup negative margins stay as they are

credit.boxNote: NOS Design ruling 2026-10-28: match the old lockup height. 229 wide x about 183 tall (+/-4), max-width:100% and height:auto so nothing overflows at 768-1023 or 390. The box is asserted at 1440 and 390; at the overflow widths only no-overflow and an upper bound are asserted.
credit.alt: South African Orchid Council — Making a difference since 1968
credit.altNote: Equals SaocLockup's exported ACCESSIBLE_LABEL, imported by NosFooter and never retyped; check-static alt derives the expected string from SaocLockup.tsx and compares it to this value.
